sloka: इदम् हि रक्षो मृग संनिकाशम्प्रलोभ्य माम् दूरम् अनुप्रयातम् ।हतम् कथंचित् महता श्रमेणस राक्षसो अभूत् म्रियमाण एव ॥३-५७-२२॥
transliteration: idam hi rakṣo mṛga saṁnikāśampralobhya mām dūram anuprayātam ।hatam kathaṁcit mahatā śrameṇasa rākṣaso abhūt mriyamāṇa eva ॥3-57-22॥

translations.english: O mighty Lakshmana from the way the beasts, jackals and birds too have turned in the bright direction of the Sun, crying in a frightful manner, can we hope princess Sita is safe ?
